scope: Internal canonical Git source acquisition held through actual catalog copy and one fresh retained-source consumer; existing cloning policy remains a separate provider operation.

dependency.assessment: Unchanged canonical _open_source/_clone_git_source/_run_git inspected as dependency: resolves actual commit, initializes selected submodules, bounds subprocess time/output, and owns clone-parent cleanup. Local file-protocol fixtures were executed; no remote-source or clone-storage qualification.

source_assessment: Outer producer creates the original observation ledger and debits actual live framework predecessor work before source observation. Selector/path/serialization allocations are charged against the original finite policy.

Canonical acquisition returns the genuine sanitized resolved Git reference. Only its owned clone is detached; exact HEAD bytes are compared to the resolved40/64-character commit. The local-source provenance branch remains unchanged.
Temporary-path normalization occurs once before admission, verifies a direct actual leaf and identical native facts, then pins resolved root and actual .git with original ancestry.

HEAD/config/index and optional packed-refs/shallow, original canonical source metadata, source module and selected complete no-exclusion censuses are observed through the same original ledger before caller exposure and project marker effects.

Actual original source census objects and native witnesses transfer by identity into the destination-first plan; incurred byte/file/record/metadata usage is retained rather than reset. Source actor claim requires exact root/source/selectors/policy and actual framework predecessor once.

Plan binds source actor identity and genuine ref. Provenance checks the actual source actor against acknowledged wire fields; descriptive/fabricated actors cannot select the authenticated shared path.

Source registry binds exact original references, PID/thread and immutable input/census witnesses. Native close rechecks actual root/ancestry/input/selected tree facts, followed by callback-free registry lifetime closure.

Copy stores the original actual source lifetime tuple. Its own final pure _close_record invokes source._close_lifetime after native callbacks, closing source revocation during the final copy guard without a further filesystem callback.

Nested copy admission retires before source admission; source registry retires before pinned descriptor teardown and canonical clone cleanup. Cleanup failure does not mint ownership; existing canonical cleanup behavior is not newly qualified as general garbage collection.
Framework predecessor is debited once in outer source ledger; creating copy claims that same actor/policy and omits a duplicate debit. Actual framework+Git catalog+source composition passes.

coverage: Real canonical file:// immutable commit clone, exact Git provenance, actual copy teardown and retained-source move/metadata/finalization; clone cleanup after use.
Original HEAD and selected checkout payload mutation refuse before selected entry effect.
Fabricated actor and saved description refusal before project pending publication.
Original source file ceiling refuses before project markers and private copy setup.
Symbolic revision records actual resolved detached commit.
Actual copy/source registry revocation before canonical clone cleanup.
Actual framework predecessor and Git catalog share one retained-source move.
Source final guard and copy final guard callback revocation refusal; expired source/copy cannot create a fresh source plan.

limits: Canonical clone/fetch/checkout/submodule storage and subprocess policy are separate unchanged provider behavior; clone repository size is NOT bounded by or charged as copy payload budget.
Local source-backed POSIX maintained execution only. No remote network source, SHA256 repository, independent Windows/Linux, installed-wheel or complete native-platform qualification.
No bespoke probes/reproduction scripts, predecessor replay, independent broad regression or standalone local-default matrix; default compatibility was source-reviewed at the optional branches.

No continuous hostile snapshot, general clone cleanup/GC authority, public catalog API completion, durable restart/recovery, full metadata/root/shared/wrapper ownership, full retained-layout program or release acceptance.
All five subjects and dependency hashes rechecked unchanged after terminal execution. No implementation/test/pin edits, installs, new agents or external service writes.
No independent process remains live. Source inspection/execution complete; safe to unfreeze from reviewer side after parent-owned jobs permit.
All previous independent reports remain immutable.
